content.text: I checked every figure in the brief against the release line by line.

facts.evidence: Home Depot delivered second-quarter fiscal 2026 sales of $47.9 billion, up 5.7%... Net sales for the quarter were $47,861 million, an increase of $2.6 billion, or 5.7%, from the second quarter of fiscal 2025.
Net earnings were $4,766 million and diluted EPS was $4.79, versus $4,551 million and $4.58 in the prior-year quarter.
Adjusted diluted EPS (non-GAAP, excluding acquired intangible asset amortization and related tax effects) was $4.92 versus $4.68.
Comparable sales rose 1.7%; U.S. comparable sales rose 1.3%.
Operating income was $6,839 million, up 4.3%; operating margin was 14.3% versus 14.5% a year ago.
Fiscal 2026 guidance was reaffirmed: total sales growth of approximately 2.5% to 4.5%... Full-year diluted EPS is guided to grow approximately flat to 4.0% from $14.23 in fiscal 2025
Comparable customer transactions declined 1.0% while comparable average ticket rose 2.8%
For the six months, operating cash flow was $11,422 million (versus $8,968 million)
For the six months, ... cash dividends $4,643 million. (Prior-year comparative of $4,574 million is not given, but the fiscal 2026 six-month figure, period and basis are correct.)
Guidance includes IEEPA tariff refunds, which are expected to partially offset unplanned fuel, energy and other product input costs throughout the fiscal year.

claims.claim: Second-quarter fiscal 2026 sales were $47.9 billion.
Second-quarter sales were up 5.7%.
Comparable sales were up 1.7% in the quarter.
The company reaffirmed its full-year fiscal 2026 guidance.
Net sales for the quarter were $47,861 million.
Quarterly net sales increased $2.6 billion, or 5.7%, from the second quarter of fiscal 2025.
U.S. comparable sales rose 1.3%.
Gross profit was $16,115 million, up 6.5%.
Selling, general and administrative expense was $8,424 million, up 8.5%.
Total operating expenses rose 8.2%.
Operating income was $6,839 million, up 4.3%.
Operating margin was 14.3%, versus 14.5% a year ago.
Net earnings were $4,766 million, versus $4,551 million in the prior-year quarter.
Diluted EPS was $4.79, versus $4.58 in the prior-year quarter.
Adjusted diluted EPS (non-GAAP) was $4.92, versus $4.68.
The adjusted diluted EPS measure excludes acquired intangible asset amortization and the related tax effects.
Adjusted operating income (non-GAAP) was $7,017 million.
Adjusted operating margin (non-GAAP) was 14.7%, versus 14.8%.
For the six months ended August 2, 2026, net sales were $89,626 million, up 5.3%.
Six-month comparable sales rose 1.2%.
Six-month diluted EPS was $8.09.
Six-month adjusted diluted EPS (non-GAAP) was $8.35.
The release provides no segment-level results.
Comparable customer transactions declined 1.0%.
Comparable average ticket rose 2.8%.
Average ticket was $92.50.
Customer transactions were 443.2 million, down 0.8%.
The customer transaction and average ticket measures exclude HD Supply and SRS.
CFO Richard McPhail said results "exceeded our expectations" with "broad based demand across the business as customers continued to engage in smaller projects."
Acquired intangible asset amortization was $178 million in the quarter.
Of the quarterly acquired intangible asset amortization, $125 million related to SRS Distribution.
The company ended the quarter with 2,364 retail stores.
The company operated over 1,340 SRS locations.
The company employs over 470,000 associates.
Guidance calls for total sales growth of approximately 2.5% to 4.5%.
Guidance calls for comparable sales growth of approximately flat to 2.0%.
Guidance calls for approximately 15 new stores.
Guidance calls for gross margin of approximately 33.1%.
Guidance calls for operating margin of approximately 12.4% to 12.6%.
Guidance calls for adjusted operating margin (non-GAAP) of approximately 12.8% to 13.0%.
Guidance calls for an effective tax rate of approximately 24.3%.
Guidance calls for net interest expense of approximately $2.3 billion.
Guidance calls for capital expenditures of approximately 2.5% of total sales.
Full-year diluted EPS is guided to grow approximately flat to 4.0% from $14.23 in fiscal 2025.
Full-year adjusted diluted EPS (non-GAAP) is guided to grow approximately flat to 4.0% from $14.69 in fiscal 2025.
Guidance includes IEEPA tariff refunds expected to partially offset unplanned fuel, energy and other product input costs throughout the fiscal year.
At August 2, 2026, cash and cash equivalents were $2,085 million.
At August 2, 2026, merchandise inventories were $26,847 million, versus $24,843 million a year earlier.
At August 2, 2026, short-term debt was $4,248 million.
At August 2, 2026, current installments of long-term debt were $4,697 million.
At August 2, 2026, long-term debt excluding current installments was $43,951 million.
At August 2, 2026, total stockholders' equity was $16,617 million.
Six-month operating cash flow was $11,422 million, versus $8,968 million.
Six-month capital expenditures were $1,724 million.
Six-month payments for businesses acquired, net, were $1,333 million.
Six-month repayments of long-term debt were $3,040 million.
Six-month cash dividends were $4,643 million.
Guidance relies on IEEPA tariff refunds to partially offset unplanned fuel, energy and product input costs.
Six-month comparable sales of 1.2% sit inside the full-year flat-to-2.0% guidance range.
Inventories are above prior-year levels.
The six-month financing section of the cash flow statement shows dividends but no share repurchase line item.
The forward-looking statements flag share repurchases as subject to continuation or suspension.
